transcript.text: Maya, I need to flag a significant issue. My review of the October collections file, completed yesterday and still in my working paper pending monthly risk-pack circulation, shows 6% historical dilution rather than the 3% assumed in the draft. Under our risk methodology, this requires an 8% dilution reserve. Additionally, $4,000,000 of the receivables are affiliate balances that must be excluded, leaving an eligible pool of exactly $26,000,000 — not $30,000,000. The draft transaction assumptions on eligibility and dilution need to be revised before we can proceed.
